views.name: v_school_profile
views.create_sql: CREATE VIEW v_school_profile AS SELECT schools.CDSCode, schools.School, schools.District, schools.County, schools.City, schools.Zip, schools.Latitude, schools.Longitude, schools.Charter, schools.FundingType, frpm."Academic Year" AS academic_year, frpm."Charter School (Y/N)" AS charter_school_yn, frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12, frpm."Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS free_meal_count, frpm."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" AS pct_eligible_free, frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_count, frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS pct_eligible_frpm, satscores.rtype, satscores.enroll12, satscores.NumTstTakr, satscores.AvgScrRead, satscores.AvgScrMath, satscores.AvgScrWrite, satscores.NumGE1500, schools.NCESDist, schools.NCESSchool, schools.StatusType, schools.Street, schools.StreetAbr, schools.State, schools.MailStreet, schools.MailStrAbr, schools.MailCity, schools.MailZip, schools.MailState, schools.Phone, schools.Ext, schools.Website, schools.OpenDate, schools.ClosedDate, schools.CharterNum, schools.DOC, schools.DOCType, schools.SOC, schools.SOCType, schools.EdOpsCode, schools.EdOpsName, schools.EILCode, schools.EILName, schools.GSoffered, schools.GSserved, schools.Virtual, schools.Magnet, schools.AdmFName1, schools.AdmLName1, schools.AdmEmail1, schools.AdmFName2, schools.AdmLName2, schools.AdmEmail2, schools.AdmFName3, schools.AdmLName3, schools.AdmEmail3, schools.LastUpdate, frpm.CDSCode AS frpm_CDSCode, frpm."County Code", frpm."District Code", frpm."School Code", frpm."County Name", frpm."District Name", frpm."School Name", frpm."District Type", frpm."School Type", frpm."Educational Option Type", frpm."NSLP Provision Status", frpm."Charter School Number", frpm."Charter Funding Type", frpm.IRC, frpm."Low Grade", frpm."High Grade", frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", frpm."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)", frpm."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)", frpm."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)", frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)", frpm."2013-14 CALPADS Fall 1 Certification Status", satscores.cds, satscores.sname, satscores.dname, satscores.cname FROM schools LEFT JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode LEFT JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
